description:
Degrading Quality

Everything you buy is getting worse — and most people don’t even notice.

Degrading Quality breaks down how modern products are quietly declining — from appliances and electronics to housing, food, and everyday essentials. We analyze why things don’t last like they used to, who benefits from it, and what you can actually do to avoid wasting money.

This isn’t just about complaining — it’s about understanding the system behind it.

New videos every week.

📌 WHAT YOU’LL FIND HERE:
→ Why products fail faster than ever
→ The truth behind “premium” brands
→ Planned obsolescence explained simply
→ What repair experts actually recommend
→ Products that still deliver real quality
→ Hidden tactics like shrinkflation and cost-cutting

If you’re tired of replacing things that should last — you’re in the right place.

🔔 Subscribe for weekly deep dives into the products you rely on.

#DegradingQuality #PlannedObsolescence #ConsumerTruth
